scope: Route the existing diagnostic getter and physical-buffer lock context through SoundLifetimeAccess, expose the resolved manager +10 section, and compare SoundLifetimeAccess with NativeResourceSupportLifetime by semantic-object or raw-cell identity. No host publication, deletion binding, startup, shutdown, CMake, ledger, or Ghidra mutation is included.

getter.schedule: Warm first publication returns immediately. Cold path performs first manager lookup; captures manager+10; enters and increments captured section+18; rechecks publication; allocates four bytes, writes CE752C and publishes; performs a second manager lookup; registers the then-current publication; releases the captured section; finally reloads publication. Registration failure retains the publication and releases the captured guard.

scalar.schedule: Clears current 0109CF14, writes base profile CE3818, frees the captured owner only for flags bit zero, and returns the original address. It does not unregister itself.

source_changes.sound_lifetime_access: SoundLifetimeManagerView::native_system_section_10 reads the already-resolved semantic projection or raw manager+10. SoundLifetimeAccess identity helpers compare a semantic object or the address of a raw publication cell.
source_changes.diagnostic_getter: native_diagnostic_sink_get_or_create_004c14c0 takes SoundLifetimeAccess by value and preserves the existing recheck, second-getter, current-publication registration, guard release and final-reload schedule.
source_changes.physical_lock_context: actual_lifetime_01090aa0 is a SoundLifetimeAccess value; Win32 sizeof is asserted as 16 bytes.
source_changes.resource_support: NativeResourceSupportLifetime gains one cross-adapter predicate. Semantic mode compares the SingletonLifetimeDomain object; raw mode compares the 01090AA0 cell address. It does not replace either adapter.
source_changes.compile_sensitive_guards: Current baseline native_stream_clone.cpp and native_mesh_buffer_fields.cpp already call NativeResourceSupportLifetime::borrows_same_domain on the physical-lock lifetime. The new overload satisfies those checks; no source edit to either caller was necessary.
source_changes.construction: The changes create no manager or diagnostic cell. Access values only borrow existing semantic or raw lifetime identity.

identity_contract.semantic: Both adapters must point at the same SingletonLifetimeDomain object.
identity_contract.raw: Both adapters must borrow the same void* volatile 01090AA0 cell address.
identity_contract.rejected: Distinct raw cells remain distinct even when both current values are null; adapter object addresses and current pointer values are never used as identity.

validation.coff: Six relevant fresh objects are x86 and carry DEFAULTLIB:MSVCRT. Symbols establish the value-form diagnostic getter, native_system_section_10, the cross-adapter predicate, and both physical lock wrappers.

fixture.retirement_boundary: The fixture directly unregisters and scalar-deletes the owner, then destroys an empty raw manager. It does not supply a fake deletion dispatcher or claim production raw-drain admission.

boundaries.phase2_required: A later packet must own a stable GameSingletonHost 0109CF14 cell and append CE752C to NativeSingletonDeletionBindings after the current frame-clock tail. This packet deliberately leaves both untouched.
boundaries.shutdown_wrapper: Original 007363B0 unregister/scalar shutdown remains a separate source packet.
boundaries.no_original_abi: These are typed C++ source interfaces, not drop-in cdecl/ECX native replacements.
boundaries.no_native_eh: C++ EH cleanup preserves the established source schedule; original FH3/SEH identity, asynchronous faults and second-exception behavior are unproved.
boundaries.no_runtime_claim: No application startup/shutdown, production context composition, renderer/device behavior, game execution or gameplay validation is claimed.
boundaries.no_metadata_mutation: No Ghidra, ledger, name or tag mutation was performed.

hash_provenance: Native SHA-256 values were computed programmatically from exact installed-PE spans and accepted only after byte-for-byte equality with fresh guarded Ghidra reads. Source, object, library, executable, log and report hashes are generated from retained files by the archive manifest; no abbreviated hash was expanded manually.
